model_selection.reason: Bounded nontrivial implementation per AGENTS; architecture/security reviewed Astra separately

requirements: Exact paths only; no Main/control/registry/Kernel/f13/lock/dependency edits, no source overlap. Publish shared Go DTO/API source pin before dependent owner codes against it. Root integrates shared definitions serially.

Implement frozen RPC contract and security conditions: Windows only, pinned Native0.166, new128bit nonce per process, no inherited CODEX_HOME/home semicolon, fixed memory scalar false, no extensions/permission/CWD/model config from user input; original requested deny/minimal/source-read/networkfalse stays.

PREPARATION_READY is only audited canonicalRPC preparation, public verification remains UNVERIFIED/enforcement false; legacy exec stays blocked. No READY bool or serialized receipt import or environment override can qualify production.

One actual OS capture pipe for BOTH Native stdout/stderr, bounded processing and durable partial failure. Any startup warning/unknown/invalid/truncated capture blocks prompt. One fresh local thread, actual nonce id/no extends/readOnly/no network/never approval checks; first turn ONLY threadId/input, no settings/env/reconnect/override RPC.

Existing original Job before Resume, private perRun single-use permit and BeforeModelTurn recheck owner/source snapshot/path/revision/identity/seal/epoch/cancel; persist consumed intent before write, partial/unknown never retransmit or relaunch. Existing domainstore/journal only, no new scheduler/DB.

No actual Native CLI/auth/model/echo/probe, admin/setup/install/push or reading private Native files in author scope. Root registers every real operation separately. Qualification absent must fail before prompt as QUALIFICATION_REQUIRED; B3 actual synthetic producer is separate scope, never fake production pass.

Freeze source/patch/checks/failed iterations in new C evidence; no old artifact overwrite or failure counter reset. Go child tests must be proposed to Root original-f13 registration; do not run unsupervised. No self-signing actual/product acceptance. Public harness.v1 rev2 DTO stays exact.

Wait for exact B1 Go interface source pin, do not guess methods or edit B1 files. Domain uses shared preparation predicate and canonicaltransport identity, seals distinct policy/command identity without upgrading old profiles/tasks. BeforeModelTurn gets actualGo evidence from driver, reopens original harnessGate and compares current source to captured driver values, consumes durable turn intent once.

Host factory selects only new audited RPC constructor when supported; no fallback to unsafe exec. Preserve normal native auth ownership and current executable discovery. Qualification provider defaults unavailable until separately reviewed B3 actual producer; no CLI/HTTP setting or receiptJSON mint path.
